propositions: Plan-review attestations must record signed material pins for direct children and prerequisites to bind related ticket identity, role, and current fingerprint, such that later enforcement can detect when pinned targets have drifted materially.

When pin enforcement is enabled, material drift in a pinned child or prerequisite must invalidate only the direct dependent review without eager transitive propagation, while disabled enforcement reports drift as advisory without invalidating the attestation.

Execution-phase reviews must apply a fixed 0.80 priority-floor threshold to blocking criteria (except prerequisite-consistency which uses 0.60) and require compatible phase on close only when both enforcement flags are enabled together.

Pre-sign review collection must perform a bounded full fresh reducer snapshot under the store write lock, comparing all dimensions atomically, and abort on any relationship membership or fingerprint change before signing the manifest.

Prerequisite consistency evaluation must deterministically determine for each direct prerequisite whether the subject plan is consistent, finding, or indeterminate, with complete coverage required for certification and every upheld finding carrying a verified canonical prerequisite ID.

Legacy unpinned attestations and older readers must remain compatible: unknown additive manifest lines must not alter signature reproduction, and pre-feature snapshots must bootstrap plan_review_phase idempotently from compiled status on first post-upgrade reduction.
